summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) for its hub-and-spoke uranium and vanadium production strategy in Utah and Colorado. The PEA covers the Shootaring Canyon Mill and tributary mines, reporting a pre-tax IRR of 106% and NPV of US$606 million based on US$100/lb uranium and US$9/lb vanadium, with average annual production of 1.3M lbs U3O8 and 6.4M lbs V2O5 over 15 years. Total mill capex is estimated at US$80.1 million. This is a routine technical disclosure under NI 43-101 and does not constitute a special situation.
